import CategoryTheory.Limits
import CategoryTheory.ModuleCategory

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {R : Type u} [Ring R] : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasFiniteBiproducts (ModuleCat R) := by
  let C := ModuleCat R
  let I : Type v := Fin n -- for some n, but we use a general approach
  let F : I → C := λ i, Module.of R (Fin.card i) -- placeholder for actual module construction

  have : ∀ (n : ℕ), HasFiniteProducts C n := by
    intro n
    apply HasFiniteProducts.of_has_finite_products
    apply has_binary_products
    exact ModuleCat.has_binary_products

  have : ∀ (n : ℕ), HasFiniteCoproducts C n := by
    intro n
    apply HasFiniteCoproducts.of_has_finite_coproducts
    apply has_binary_coproducts
    exact ModuleCat.has_binary_coproducts

  have : ∀ (n : ℕ), HasFiniteBiproducts C n := by
    intro n
    apply HasFiniteBiproducts.of_has_finite_products_and_coproducts
    exact this
    exact this

  exact HasFiniteBiproducts.of_has_finite_products_and_coproducts this this
